note: Read by node scripts and tests only; never imported by the app, so nothing here is in what a browser loads (check:dictionary proves it against dist). It records why each added word, each course word and each English search word is in the dictionary (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-18): for an added word or a course word, the sources that attest it, as a citation and never a source's wording; for an English search word, the row's own meaning quoted from the data, or a source and a place in it. One row per source for each item is in audits/dictionary-search-2026-11-18/additions-evidence.tsv in the project folder.
